subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost use a fixed 30-second WebSocket upgrade deadline, matching the established sibling reliability pattern?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but choosing when a slow yet potentially valid external upgrade becomes a failed attempt is an operational availability policy decision.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Land the proven fixed deadline so stalled upgrades reliably return control to the reconnect loop without adding configuration.

options.title: Revise the fixed deadline
options.body: Choose another plugin-owned constant and update the proof if supported Mattermost or proxy deployments require a longer upgrade window.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the proven fixed deadline so stalled upgrades reliably return control to the reconnect loop without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance and merged Mattermost history make this the strongest available owner for the channel’s connection policy.
